verses.text: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የሕዝቅያስ ወዳጆች ያለ ጥርጥር የጻፉት የተለያየ የሰሎሞን ተግሣጽ ነው።
የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ነገርን ይሰውራል፥
ሰማይ ከፍ ያለ ነው፥ ምድርም ጥልቅ ነው፥
ያልጠራውን ብር አጥራው፥
ከንጉሡ ፊት ክፉዎችን አጥፋ፥
በንጉሥ ፊት አትታበይ፥
በመኰንን ፊት ከምቷረድ፦
ኋላ እንዳትጸጸት፥
ባልንጀራህ በነቀፈህ ጊዜ ወደኋላህ ተመለስ፥
ምሥጢሩን ብትገልጥ ግን የሞት ያህል ይሆንብሃል፥
As gold is pleasing upon silver, so shall be the beauty of the righteous.
As the value of gold is much, so shall be the beauty of the righteous, which is called a precious ornament.
In the days of adversity, as the joy of the heart is like a sweet song,
All who seek after deceitful riches,
The beauty of life shall declare itself in patience.
My son, take heed that thou be not entangled, nor be led astray.
That it may not deceive thee, nor may it pursue thee.
In the house of the deceitful, there is a snare laid in falsehood.
The way of the wicked and the path of the sinner,
As a well that is not fit for drinking, so is a deceitful heart.
If your enemy is hungry, feed him;
If you do this, you will heap coals of fire upon his head;
The north wind brings forth rain;
It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop than with a brawling woman in a wide house;
The water that is drawn from the well is good for the thirsty body;
Before the Almighty, the fall of the righteous is a great matter;
Eating much honey is not good;
A city that is broken down, without walls, is like a man who has no control over his spirit;
The desire of the wicked is as a vapor, and there is no profit in the summer.
As the wind blows, so shall it be; and as the storm rages, so shall it be.
A bridle for the horse, a way of escape for the steed, as it is.
My son, do not be like him, lest you resemble him.
Yet, let him be wise for himself, that he may not be likened to another.
A messenger of the heavens sends forth a word.
The feet of the swift are indeed unique.
To the swift, honor is given.
As the shadow in the summer, so is the hand that gives.
The nature of the unlearned is often greatly known.
As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool returns to his folly.
I have seen a man wise in his own conceit; there is more hope of a fool than of him.
A lowly man, when he is sent, says, "There is a lion in the way;
as a slothful man turns upon his bed,
a lowly man hides his hand in his bosom;
a lowly man is more likely to return a message in a lazy manner than a wise man,
and he who passes by another's folly is like one who is caught in a snare.
Let them be judged, for they who love the things of men are like those who bring forth evil.
All who despise their neighbors are like this;
by the wood, the fire shall be quenched.
From the sting of a scorpion, and from the wood that sets fire,
The word of the mighty is weak,
A coin given in deceit is like a mirage,
The enemy, lurking in wait, shall be given hope in his breath,
Though your enemy may rejoice with a loud voice, do not be deceived,
He who conceals his enmity shall be caught in his own snare,
He who digs a pit for his neighbor shall fall into it himself,
A deceitful tongue pursues truth with enmity,
Yet the one who brings forth shall not know what it is.
Another shall praise thee, but thy own mouth shall not.
A stone is heavy, and the burden of wrath is grievous;
There is no mercy for the one who provokes and stirs up wrath.
The revealed is a veil.
Better is a good counsel from an enemy than a deceitful kiss from a friend.
The body that is adorned with myrrh shall be awakened;
As a bird that flutters from its nest, so is a man who departs from his place.
In sickness and in bitterness, the heart rejoices in wine.
Do not forsake thy friend, nor the friend of thy father.
My son, let your heart rejoice, and be wise in your understanding.
A wise man is cautious in the time of calamity; he shall be preserved.
For the enemy that seeks to destroy another has come upon him.
He who speaks great words against his neighbor is a man who shall be brought low.
The flood shall carry a man from his house in the winter season.
The wind from the south is strong.
Iron sharpens iron; so shall one man sharpen another.
The fruit of the vine that is cultivated shall be eaten.
As face answers to face, so does one heart reflect another.
Hell and death shall not be satisfied.
ወርቅና ብር በእሳት ግለት ይፈተናሉ፥
አላዋቂን በማዋረድ በጉባኤ መካከል ብትገርፈው፥
የበጎችህን መንፈስ አስተውለህ ዕወቅ፥
ግዛትም፥ ኀይልም ለዘለዓለም ለሰው አይደለም፥
የምድረ በዳ ልምላሜን ጠብቅ፥
በጎችን ለልብስ ገንዘብ ታደርግ ዘንድ፥
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ የጸናች ቃል አለችህ፥
He who does not take heed shall be led astray;
By the wicked, in the way of sin, he shall be ensnared;
The man who is ensnared by sin shall be brought low;
Those who forsake the law and despise sin are indeed like this.
The wicked do not regard justice;
From the deceitful and the treacherous,
The son who keeps the law is wise;
In the midst of abundance and in the presence of plenty,
He who turns his ear away from hearing the law is a fool;
He leads the righteous astray by a wicked path.
A man who is deceitful is regarded as wise in his own eyes;
There is much honor in the deliverance of the righteous;
The path of one who commits iniquity shall not be made straight;
A man who is continually vexed for righteousness is blessed;
He who oppresses the poor while himself being poor is a wicked oppressor;
A king whose mind is corrupted shall be a heavy burden to many;
A man who is filled with the blood of others is a murderer;
The one who walks in the path of righteousness shall be delivered;
He who plows the land shall eat of its bread;
A faithful man shall be greatly blessed;
የጻድቃንን ፊት የማያፍር ሰው ደግ አይደለም፥
ምቀኛ ሰው ባለጠጋ ለመሆን ይቸኩላል፥
በምላሱ ከሚሸነግል ሰው ይልቅ
ከአባቱና ከእናቱ የሚሰርቅ፥
የሚሳሳ ሰው ከንቱን ይፈርዳል፤
በልቡ ደስታ የሚታመን ሰው እንደዚሁ ሰነፍ ነው፤
ለድሃ የሚሰጥ አይቸገርም፤
በኃጥኣን ቦታ ጻድቃን ያለቅሳሉ፥
Better is a man who is humble than one who is proud,
The nations rejoice in the praise of the righteous;
A father delights in a son who loves wisdom;
A true king strengthens his nation;
A man who prepares a feast before his beloved;
The wicked man will increase in calamity and strife;
The righteous will regard the judgment of the poor;
The wicked will destroy the city;
A wise man will lead the people;
Those who conspire to shed blood will pursue the righteous man.
A foolish man unleashes all his wrath;
If a king should utter a deceitful matter,
The oppressor and the oppressed shall meet in due time;
A king who judges truly for the poor,
In wisdom, they shall provide understanding through diligence;
When wickedness increases, sin abounds;
Chasten your son, and he shall give you rest;
There is no teacher for a sinful people;
An evil servant shall not be corrected by words;
When you see a man who is distressed by words,
The slothful man shall be a servant from his infancy;
The diligent man shall be favored;
Pride shall bring a man low;
He who consorts with a thief shall bring destruction upon his own soul;
The fearful and the timid shall be ensnared;
Many shall flatter before the mighty;
A true man is one who is despised by the oppressor;
Who can find a virtuous woman?
For she is worth far more than rubies; her husband’s heart trusts in her, and he will have no lack of gain.
She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
She seeks wool and flax, and works with willing hands.
She is like the ships of the merchant; she brings her food from afar.
She rises while it is yet night and provides food for her household.
She considers a field and buys it; with the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
She girds herself with strength and makes her arms strong.
She perceives that her merchandise is profitable; her lamp does not go out at night.
She stretches out her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
እጅዋን ለችግረኛ ትዘረጋለች፥
ባሏ በውጭ የዘገየ እንደ ሆነ በቤት ስላሉት ምንም አያስብም ።
ለባሏ እጥፍ ሆኖ ከተፈተለ የተልባ እግር መጐናጸፊያ ትሠራለች፤
ባልዋ በሀገር ሽማግሌዎች መካከል በሸንጎ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ፥
የበፍታ ቀሚስ እየሠራች ትሸጣለች።
ብርታትንና ውበትን ትለብሳለች፤
ወደ ቤትዋ የሚገባ ብዙ ነው፥
ሕግና ምጽዋት በአፍዋ አለ፥
ምጽዋቷ ልጆችዋን ያሳድጋል፥ ያበለጥጋልም፤
“ብዙ ሴቶች ልጆች ሀብትን ሰበሰቡ፤
ውበት ሐሰት ነው፥ ደምግባትም ከንቱ ነው፤
ከከንፈሯ ፍሬ ስጡአት፥
